categories.main_business_segments: Gaon Cable Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two business segments: the Power Cable Division, producing and selling power cables mainly to Korea Electric Power Corporation, and the Communication Cable Division, producing and selling communication cables primarily to KT and related customers. The company also engages in construction and electrical works related to high-voltage cable installation and has subsidiaries specializing in various cable manufacturing and related businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced cable manufacturing technologies focusing on power and communication cables, including insulated wires, copper rods, LAN cables, and optical fiber cables. It emphasizes cost reduction and quality assurance through investments in production facilities and technology innovation, including development of specialized cables for railway vehicles, electric vehicle charging couplers, and UL-certified cables. Production capacity is supported by multiple plants with high utilization rates and ongoing capital investments in machinery and equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include Korea Electric Power Corporation for power cables and KT for communication cables, serving both domestic and export markets. The company targets infrastructure sectors such as power transmission and distribution, telecommunications, and industrial applications. Export markets include the United States, France, Australia, Myanmar, China, and Thailand, with recent strategic investments in Southeast Asia and North America to expand global presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing plants in Gunpo, Osan, Iksan, Cheonan, Jeonju, and Goesan. It has expanded its reach through subsidiaries and overseas investments, including a joint venture in Myanmar and investments in the United States. The company actively pursues export growth in North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gaon Cable operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of power and communication cables. It procures raw materials such as copper rods and insulating materials, processes them into finished cable products, and sells directly to utility companies, telecommunications providers, and industrial customers. The company also engages in downstream activities like installation and construction services related to cable deployment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in developing advanced cable products including railway vehicle cables, electric vehicle charging connectors, and specialized cables for submarine and industrial Ethernet applications. It maintains a dedicated R&D organization focusing on production technology innovation and quality improvement. Strategic initiatives include cost reduction, quality assurance, and expanding product competitiveness in both power and communication cable sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured power and communication cables, including both products and related construction services. The company employs a direct sales model focusing on customer contracts with some advance payments for new customers. Export sales contribute significantly to revenue, and internal transactions among subsidiaries are eliminated in consolidated financials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Gaon Cable is one of the top three cable manufacturers in South Korea, competing with major players such as LS Cable & System and Daehan Cable. The company holds a strong market position domestically with expanding international presence. Competition is based on product quality, reliability, delivery performance, and increasingly on environmental friendliness and large-capacity cable solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Gaon Cable reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.5 trillion KRW with operating income of 43.7 billion KRW and net income of 17.9 billion KRW, reflecting a 5.8% revenue growth and 53.6% operating profit increase over the prior year. The company maintains a solid financial structure with a debt-to-equity ratio of 142.3% and a self-capital ratio of 41.3%. Capital expenditures and R&D investments support ongoing growth and competitiveness.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gaon Cable emphasizes customer-centric sales and product differentiation through superior quality, cost competitiveness, and technological innovation in power and communication cables. The company leverages direct sales channels and strategic investments in production capacity and R&D to meet diverse customer needs. Its value proposition includes reliable supply for critical infrastructure, advanced cable solutions for emerging markets like electric vehicles and railways, and proactive risk management in raw material sourcing.
